name: Vael
desc: Tall river-folk of the slow brown waters. Patient, fair-spoken, and luckier than they deserve.

name: Korrun
desc: Stone-blooded mountain clans. They count their dead in granite and forget nothing but their manners.

name: Fennick
desc: Small, quick hedge-people. A Fennick can steal the rain off your hood and sell it back as weather.

name: Aldari
desc: Long-lived starlight lineage, pale as frost on iron. They remember the fen before the town.

name: Half-Wyld
desc: Touched by the old forest. Green-eyed, restless, and ill-favoured by tame gods.
